messages:
Ashley C: T-minus 45 until EU change window (22:00 UTC). Quick run: checklist + rollback lanes. I'll capture owners — ping when ready.
Mike B: Irene on release notes & smoke? Luke on oncall?
Irene K: I can own release notes & post-deploy smoke. Notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-21-3.14 — DB migration flagged in notes.
Luke (oncall): I'll be oncall for 60m after cutover. Set alert thresholds: +3% error-rate and >2x p95 latency. I'll escalate.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued deploy v3.14 -> prod scheduled 22:15 UTC. Canary 5% starting now. Command: `/deploy run 3.14 --canary=5 --timeout=15m`
Sophia R: Canary metrics from earlier run looked clean. CPU on host-pool-a ~60% avg. No errors.
Sam T: Heads-up: frontend version is locked; I will hold the unpin until smoke passes. `frontend.lock: v3.12 -> unlock`
Ashley C: Checklist (tick when done):
- DB migration readme confirmed (Irene)
- Canaries green (Sophia)
- Release notes posted (Irene)
- Traffic-shift plan (Mike)
- Rollback owner defined (Luke)
- Ops silence period set (Sam)
- Post-deploy smoke (Irene)
- Telemetry targets live (oncall)
Mike B: Traffic shift plan: 0 -> 5 -> 20 -> 100 over ~30m if no regressions. Manual holdpoints at 5% and 20%. I'll trigger.
Irene K: Smoke test snippet: `curl -sS https://staging.internal/health | jq .` expecting `{"ok":true}` and sample gen latency <200ms.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary 5% started at 3175003100 — monitoring channels: #metrics, #eng-sre. Deploy will auto-pause on alerts.
Sophia R: @Ashley seeing a small mem bump on canary pod-7 (+10MB). Not critical, watching.
Luke (oncall): Rollback criteria: sustained 5xxs >0.5% for 3m OR p95 >500ms over 3m => rollback to v3.13. If triggered I'll run `deploy rollback --to v3.13` and announce.
Sam T: :thumbsup: Holding unpin until Irene gives smoke pass. If rollback happens, do NOT unpin.
Irene K: Smoke pass at 22:24 UTC — endpoints green, sample prompts OK. Ready for 20%.
Mike B: Moving to 20% now. Triggering traffic shift. `/deploy shift --to 20%`
release-bot: release-bot: changelog published and customers-notify list queued. Release notes v3.14 published.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic at 20% (3175003800). No alerts in last 5m. Next step 100% in 20m unless hold.
Ashley C: If emergency rollback, open #release-war-room and ping @all. Luke will coordinate.
Sophia R: Metrics steady: p95 180ms, error rate 0.03%.
Irene K: Post-deploy smoke completed at 22:45 UTC. OK to finish rollout.
Mike B: Starting final shift to 100%. `/deploy shift --to 100%`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: shift to 100% in progress (3175004800). Rolling to all regions. Expected finish ~22:55 UTC.
release-bot: release-bot: final release notes posted and internal slack snippet pinned in #product.
Luke (oncall): All good here. Keeping watch for 30m. If anything odd, open an incident and tag me.
Ashley C: :tada: Launch complete. Thanks all. I'll file follow-ups if needed.
